passages.note: Assembly Floor vote; Ward is listed among the Ayes on final passage of SCA 10.

passages.provision_quote: The state shall not deny or interfere with an individual’s reproductive freedom in their most intimate decisions, which includes their fundamental right to choose to have an abortion and their fundamental right to choose or refuse contraceptives.
passages.note: Chaptered operative text of SCA 10 states an unqualified right to choose abortion with no stage-based limit or exception.

rows.reasoning: Ward voted Aye on SCA 10 (2021-2022), whose operative text provides that "the state shall not deny or interfere with an individual's reproductive freedom in their most intimate decisions, which includes their fundamental right to choose to have an abortion," with no stage-of-pregnancy limit or exception stated. This matches rung 1, "keep abortion legal at every stage of pregnancy, with no time limit," and excludes the trimester cutoffs and exception clauses of rungs 2 through 5.
